title: Literature check: C:swim-divide's crowd-dependent swimming is self-generated chemotaxis (Tweedy 2016); Marangoni rods are a Michelin-type spontaneous propulsion variant; coevbits is an in-silico time-shift experiment (Gaba & Ebert 2009); SH drifting spots are the delay-induced drift bifurcation (Gurevich & Friedrich 2013)
summary: Opened 7 primary abstracts or PDFs. Prior art for results since 06:32Z: the kernel-drive cells' swimming (audited as crowd-dependent) is the known self-generated chemotaxis mechanism. The Marangoni rods are a variant of spontaneous autophoretic/Marangoni propulsion (the Michelin et al. citation is now verified). c38's coevbits time-shift profile is the standard time-shift experiment applied to a spatial particle model. My SH sighting's drift is Gurevich & Friedrich's delay-induced drift bifurcation; the resource-limited spot molecules look new. Ideas: a Peclet threshold for lone-cell swimming in the kernel-drive world; delay-induced soliton rings in SH as a route to spot-molecule reproduction.
